blocks.tamil_translation: Then, if you make du'a, Allah Ta'ala will not accept your du'a.” Hazrat Hudhaifah ibn Yaman (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ ﵂ قَالَتْ: قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ! أَفَنَهْلِكُ وَفِينَا الصَّالِحُونَ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ إِذَا كَثُرَ الْخَبَثُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب ياجوج ومأجوج، رقم:٧١٣٥
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Zainab bint Jahsh (RA) says, “I asked Rasulullah ﷺ, “O Rasulullah, will we be destroyed even while there are righteous people among us?” Rasulullah ﷺ replied, “Yes! When evils become prevalent.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسٍ ﵁ قَالَ: كَانَ غُلَامٌ يَهُودِيٌّ يَخْدُمُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَمَرِضَ فَأَتَاهُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَعُودُهُ، فَقَعَدَ عِنْدَ رَأْسِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ: أَسْلِمْ، فَنَظَرَ إِلي أَبِيهِ وَهُوَ عِنْدَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ: أَطِعْ أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ ﷺ،فَأَسْلَمَ فَخَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ الَّذِي أَنْقَذَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب اذا اسلم الصبي فمات...، رقم:١٣٥٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Anas (RA) narrates, “A Jewish boy used to serve Rasulullah ﷺ. When he fell ill, Rasulullah ﷺ went to visit him. The Prophet ﷺ sat by his head and said, “Become a Muslim.” He looked at his father who was standing beside him, and his father said, “Obey Abul Qasim ﷺ!” So he became a Muslim. The Prophet ﷺ left the house saying, “All praise belongs to Allah Ta'ala, who saved this boy from the (Hell) fire!”
